name: South Park
attribution: Converted from Deathrun_Southpark_V3.bsp by Linoxi (https://gamebanana.com/mods/127198, CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 as listed there). Geometry only: boxes and traps rebuilt from the map's brushes and entities, none of the author's textures, models or sounds. Shipped on the strength of credit and removal on request: tell the repository owner and the map is taken out.
blurb: A classic deathrun: a course of traps, and the activator watching them.
